## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}
airquality |> class()
loop_length <- nrow(airquality)
vec = numeric(6)
df = data.frame()
for (i in 1:loop_length){
  vec = airquality[1:6,]
  if (is.na(vec[1:6])){
  }
  else{
    df[vec[1:6]]
  }
}
```
